name: PKO Bank Polski
aliases: Powszechna Kasa Oszczędności Bank Polski S.A.

operational_complexity.value: Nationwide banking group with high-volume operations

sources.title: Tysiące pracowników PKO Banku Polskiego korzysta ze sztucznej inteligencji
sources.excerpt: Sztuczna inteligencja ma być obecna w każdym bankowym procesie i kanale, wspierać decyzje oraz automatyzować działania.
sources.translation: Artificial intelligence is intended to be present in every banking process and channel, supporting decisions and automating activities.
sources.claim: PKO Bank Polski intends to apply AI across processes and channels to automate work.

sources.title: PKO Bank Polski Q1 2025 Results
sources.excerpt: In Q1 2025, robots processed nearly 27 million cases on the automatic path.
sources.translation: In Q1 2025, robots processed nearly 27 million cases on the automatic path.
sources.claim: PKO robots processed nearly 27 million cases in Q1 2025.

sources.title: PKO Bank Polski Strategy 2025–2027
sources.excerpt: We develop tools that enable hyper-automation of processes through task / process mining and the development of an artificial intelligence team.
sources.translation: We develop tools that enable hyper-automation of processes through task and process mining and the development of an artificial intelligence team.
sources.claim: The bank's strategy explicitly invests in hyperautomation, process mining and an AI team.

sources.title: PKO Bank Polski Annual Report 2023 — Strategy and outlook
sources.excerpt: In total, 65 processes were robotised and 82 were modified in 2023.
sources.translation: In total, 65 processes were robotised and 82 were modified in 2023.
sources.claim: PKO continued expanding an established portfolio of robotised processes.

sources.title: Kariera w centrali PKO Banku Polskiego
sources.excerpt: Na co dzień zajmuję się monitoringiem biznesowym botów obsługujących klientów banku.
sources.translation: Every day I handle business monitoring of bots serving the bank's customers.
sources.claim: PKO employs specialists who monitor customer-service bots in daily operations.

assessments.rationale: The current strategy names hyperautomation as an operations optimisation lever, while reported automation volume demonstrates execution at scale.
Official strategy and newsroom evidence identify active AI, process-mining and hyperautomation initiatives.
The bank has created an AI Competence Centre and publicly describes specialist responsibility for production bot monitoring.
The strategy couples centralisation of group operations with continued automation of repetitive processes.
Strong internal capability is visible, but public sources do not establish that external delivery support is unnecessary.
No current exclusive automation delivery partner is confirmed in the reviewed official sources.

operational_complexity.value: Integrated energy group with generation, distribution and customer operations

sources.title: Umělá inteligence pomáhá ČEZ Prodej zrychlit vyřizování požadavků
sources.excerpt: Přepisy hovorů s klienty nebo automatické zpracování souhrnů telefonátů výrazně zkracuje čas potřebný k řešení zákaznických požadavků.
sources.translation: Call transcripts and automatic processing of call summaries significantly reduce the time needed to resolve customer requests.
sources.claim: ČEZ uses AI automation to reduce customer-service handling time.

sources.title: ČEZ ICT Services Annual Report 2025
sources.excerpt: Projekt BPM Camunda si kladl za cíl vybudovat skupinovou BPM platformu pro řízení a automatizaci procesů napříč celou Skupinou ČEZ.
sources.translation: The Camunda BPM project aimed to build a group-wide BPM platform for managing and automating processes across the entire ČEZ Group.
sources.claim: ČEZ is building a group-wide platform for process management and automation.

sources.title: ČEZ Group Sustainability Report 2024
sources.excerpt: In 2024, CEZ Group successfully continued to implement artificial intelligence (AI) into its processes.
sources.translation: In 2024, CEZ Group successfully continued to implement artificial intelligence into its processes.
sources.claim: ČEZ continued deploying AI into operational processes in 2024.

sources.title: ČEZ Group Annual Financial Report 2024 — Digitization
sources.excerpt: The aim of the digital transformation of the distribution system is to create a smart automated grid with increased reliability.
sources.translation: The aim of the digital transformation of the distribution system is to create a smart automated grid with increased reliability.
sources.claim: ČEZ has a defined digital-transformation programme for an automated distribution grid.

sources.title: ČEZ Group Annual Financial Report 2025
sources.excerpt: In 2025, CEZ Group also achieved success in all three ESG areas of sustainable business: Environmental, Social, and Governance.
sources.translation: In 2025, CEZ Group also achieved success in all three ESG areas of sustainable business: environmental, social and governance.
sources.claim: ČEZ reports group-wide transformation activity through its current annual reporting cycle.

assessments.rationale: Official sources connect deployed automation with shorter handling times and a group-wide process-automation platform.
The group documents ongoing AI implementation and a named digital transformation of its distribution system.
ČEZ ICT Services is delivering shared automation infrastructure and training business and IT teams to adopt it.
The group-wide BPM platform and shared customer-service automation show cross-process standardisation and consolidation.
Internal ICT capability is evident, but the sources do not prove that external automation expertise is unnecessary.
No exclusive incumbent covering the target automation scope is established by the reviewed public sources.
